//: CHARACTER BACKGROUNDS (GDD §13 'birth sets a baseline legitimacy'; §18). Applied ONCE at creation as a delta on top of the scenario's protagonist and house: legitimacy, treasury, traits added, skills, flags, stress; trackHint/ambitionHint pre-select but never force. Keep them asymmetric (GDD §17 variable emphasis): old blood buys standing, the upjumped buy skill with contempt, the merchant buys coin, the scholar buys exotics. background:<id> is written as a char flag so events can read where you came from.

backgrounds.name: Old Blood
backgrounds.description: Born to a name the old houses still bow to. Standing comes easily; so does the expectation that you will not have to earn anything.

backgrounds.name: The Upjumped
backgrounds.description: Low-born, raised by talent and a patron's whim. The old houses despise you for it, and you are better than every one of them at the actual work.

backgrounds.name: Merchant Scion
backgrounds.description: Your family bought its way into the nobility a generation ago and never stopped counting. The ledger is the only scripture you were raised on.

backgrounds.name: Soldier's Child
backgrounds.description: Raised in barracks and on troop-ships, among people who kept you alive and expected the same. You know how a force is fed, moved, and lied to.

backgrounds.name: Scholar of the Enclave
backgrounds.description: Years in a research enclave among things the markets call exotic because they cannot agree what else to call them. You see patterns; you have not learned to stop.

backgrounds.name: Ward of the Court
backgrounds.description: Fostered at a great house as a child — half hostage, half heir. You learned every corridor, every whisper, and exactly how little blood guarantees.
